name: Hotel Bayerischer Hof
positioning: Independent hotel in the heart of Munich's historic centre with its own cinema, boulevard theatre and the rooftop Blue Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a base in Munich's historic centre
Guests who like evening entertainment, films and live concerts without leaving the hotel

facts.text: The hotel is situated in the heart of Munich's historic centre.
The hotel has five restaurants and six bars.
The hotel hosts exclusive events and live concerts.
The hotel has a health and beauty oasis.
The hotel's wellness retreat is the Blue Spa.
Massages at the Blue Spa can be booked online.
The hotel offers a virtual tour on its website.

highlights.text: The hotel has its own cinema.
The hotel has its own boulevard theatre.
The Blue Spa sits high above the city's rooftops.
The hotel's event calendar ranges from films and glittering balls to culinary and cultural events.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes that the historic building may have varying room sizes.
